root_cause: After the serverless Netlify.env/process.env runtime mismatch was repaired, the exact production canary still returned HTTP 503 because portal-ondernemersdata itself required a privileged Supabase credential in the Netlify runtime. That credential was not present there. The architecture therefore coupled authenticated Portal reads to distribution of a database master credential into a second runtime even though the existing portal-state-eu authority already owns privileged Supabase access behind an authenticated service-token gateway.
prevention: Netlify Portal functions must not require a Supabase service-role or secret key when the existing portal-state-eu authority can perform the privileged read.
Netlify remains responsible for Netlify Identity authentication and server-derived tenant scope; privileged database access remains inside the Supabase Edge runtime.
The existing BG_PORTAL_EU_SERVICE_TOKEN gateway is reused; no new credential, alias, permanent test user or authentication bypass is introduced.
The Netlify adapter must reject tenant-scope drift returned by the Edge authority.
The authenticated production proof remains terminal authority and must prove HTTP 200, tenant scope, payload shape and synthetic-user cleanup on the exact production deploy.

success_criteria: Required and Powerhouse CodeQL green on the exact recovery head
portal-state-eu exact source deployed to Supabase production
PORTAL_AUTHENTICATED_PRODUCTION_PROOF_V1 status PROVEN with HTTP 200, tenant_scope_verified true, payload_shape_verified true and synthetic_user_cleanup DELETED
